messages:
marco: Quick heads-up, I'm kicking off a short shadow-metering run against a 6h slice of prod logs to validate the new 'attribution envelope' contract. Goal: detect any cases where token attribution would flip between current and proposed logic.

zoe: :eyes: do you have the contract snippet handy? would like to diff against the current envelope.

marco: yep pasted below — it's intentionally minimal, we'd like to keep provenance lightweight:
```json
{"envelope_version":"v2","request_id":"<uuid>","tenant":"<tenant_id>","tokens":{"prompt":123,"completion":45},"attribution":{"source_hint":"proxy","fallback_path":"shared-cache"}}
```

raj: important to call out: v2 collapses some intermediary attribution tags we used for legacy billing. if the shadow run finds probes that relied on those tags we'll need a compatibility shim at the ingest boundary.

olivia: how long will the run be? and are we writing results to audit-store or a temporary bucket?

marco: running for ~6h starting now. results go to s3://redwood-shadow/metering/2864100000/ — compressed CSV with both v1 and v2 attribution columns so we can do per-request diffs.

talia: +1 on storing both. can we include a mapping table for tenant overrides? a couple large tenants still use legacy quota semantics.

marco: good point. adding a tenant_override column and the tenant feature_flags snapshot for the run.

ingest-bot: shadow-job shad-286410-1 STARTED against logs [range: 2026-03-19T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-19T06:00:00Z] — writing to s3://redwood-shadow/metering/2864100000/

raj: reminder: add dedupe window metadata. previously some multi-chunk requests produced duplicate tokens when client retries hit different frontends. v2's envelope should include origin-shard + request_fingerprint so downstream dedupe can be deterministic.

marco: included request_fingerprint and origin_shard in the CSV. dedupe-window will be 2 minutes for this run so we can compare both 2m and 30s windows offline.

olivia: any plan for how we detect divergent billing outcomes? simple diff of billed_token_count per invoice key?

marco: plan is three checks: 1) per-request token delta (v2 - v1), 2) per-tenant aggregated delta, 3) classification of divergence root cause tags (dedupe, attribution-loss, rounding). we'll tag each row with a short reason code.

talia: if we see large tenant deltas we should auto-open a ticket to infra-accounting and mark the run as 'investigate' so ops isn't surprised.

audit-bot: audit-log append: shadow-run shad-286410-1 metadata: {operator:"marco", buckets:["redwood-shadow/metering/2864100000"], checks:["per-request-delta","tenant-agg-delta","rc-classification"]} at 2026-03-19T00:00:05Z

zoe: one quick ask — can we also emit a small sample of raw request payloads (redacted) for manual triage? 50 rows per tenant max.

marco: doing that; redaction: remove full prompt text, keep token counts + prompt fingerprints.

raj: after this run, we should schedule a short sync to decide go/no-go for moving the pipeline to v2 envelopes. flagging potential engineering work: compatibility shim at ingress, update reconciler to use fingerprint-based dedupe, and a migration plan for archived charge logs.

marco: thanks everyone. I'll post a short summary when the run finishes with a link to the CSV, a sample divergence report, and next-step recommendations. :thumbsup:
